about_the_game:
RELEASE NOTES

To everyone who already purchased, or is thinking about purchasing, TetrX 360 – Eons of Time.

A HUGE thank you to those of you who downloading the game and are supporting us to continue developing TetrX 360. Hope you’ll enjoy this initial release, but keep in mind this is just the beginning.

About $9.99 price.

Download, launch and you will see 1,000 CREDITS already deposited in your account, a $200 dollar value of in-app purchases. Originally, we wanted to launch with 100 credits (equivalent to $9.99 purchase price) and in-app purchase enabled, but just before lunch we opted to go with a much higher credit number. 1,000 credits will buy a lot of powerups, if rightly used, it is enough to finish the game. This is our value-for-value model, our way of saying thank you for purchasing the game.

Beginning in the second release full in-app purchase will be enabled.

Over the next 48 months a total of 33,333 levels will be released, culminating in a cinematic ending to wrap(?) this story line. We already have a dozen spin-off games planned (the imagery on some levels cries out for standalone games.)

Here is what’s coming for TetrX360 in 2026:

  • In-app purchase (Q1, 2026)

  • Full sound effects, not just music

  • Multiplayer support, this will be a unique experience

  • Co-Op support

  • Controller support

  • Three different play modes, these will be a blast

  • Thousands of new levels

  • Completely different game-play to supplement the well-known ‘falling blocks’ scheme

  • All levels will be fully animated. And we do mean fully animated

  • Interactive IO will be introduced

  • iOS support for iPad

  • a special edition 4K version for unreal, high-definition graphics and gameplay

  • dozens of additional power-ups for in-app purchase

  • Competition(s) with grand prizes

  • and a twist to in-game purchase: at the end of each month, you will receive a 25% credit bonus of the actual $ amount you spent to purchase credits (coming in Q1, 2026)

Please send us bug reports / suggestions / feature requests to help improve TetrX 360 – Eons of Time.

Special note: if for whatever reason you don’t like the game make sure that, at the least, you play until you reach Level 4 Act 2. If after that level you still don’t like TetrX 360…

Stay with us on a multi-year adventure to fully unlock all secrets of TetrX 360 – Eons of Time.

Good gaming.

TetrX 360 - Eons of Time

Dive into a thrilling puzzle adventure that ignites your strategic instincts! Each level pulses with vivid visuals and an electrifying soundtrack, pushing your quick thinking to the limit as you unlock quirky power-ups and conquer mind-bending challenges. With intuitive game play and endless replayability, this is an addictive experience that captivates casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike!

Tetris re-imagined, enhanced and wrapped in grand story line with play modes never thought of before.

Initial TetrX 360 includes:

  • A FEATURE that will make your jaw drop

  • 31 original levels  (33,333 when fully deployed over the next 48 months)

  • thousands of variations

  • millions of combinations

  • special power-ups

  • mind bending surprises

  • + watch out for a twists to the purchase

awesome of the new blocks. hundreds more 

Following initial release, in the ensuing 48 months we'll continue to add new features and levels every three months in the 1st year, every two months in the 2nd year and monthly in the 3rd and 4th years, culminating in 33,333 playable levels, all wrapped in a grand story that will provide entertainment for many subsequent years to come. 

Follow us to make sure you don't miss the release date(s). 

one of the playing fields

All images are actual in-game renderings. We'll be posting more in-game images and game-play videos on a regular basis leading up and after release.

The Portal. Gateway to all adventures beginning in the 2nd game update. Your access point to 33,333 levels.
